ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious History File Operations
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects commandline operations on shell history files

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bash\\_history.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.zsh\\_history.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.zhistory.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.history.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.sh\\_history.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*fish\\_history.*"))
